title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts Recovery Manual — Changed Monthly Installment
content:
**Clause.** The changed monthly installment of a repayment plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts is the overpayment's balance divided by the classification's maximum plan months, rounded up to the cent and never less than the classification's minimum monthly payment. The balance is the overpayment's balance due at the time of the change.

**Definitions.**

(a) *Balance*: the balance due on the overpayment record when the change is made, across all components.

(b) *Changed-plan months*: the months the balance is divided by, which are the classification's maximum plan months in the repayment plan terms; the changed-plan months are never fewer than one.

(c) *Rounded up to the cent*: any fraction of a cent raises the amount to the next whole cent.

(d) *Minimum*: the classification's minimum monthly payment in the repayment plan terms. A rounded amount below it is replaced by it.

## Illustrations on hypothetical balances

- A Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal account (60 months, minimum USD 25.00 in the plan terms) with a balance due of USD 2,500.00: 2,500.00 divided by 60 is 41.6666…, rounded up to USD 41.67, above the minimum. The changed installment is USD 41.67.
- The same classification with a balance due of USD 700.00: 700.00 divided by 60 is 11.6666…, rounded up to USD 11.67, below the minimum. The changed installment is USD 25.00.
- A Fraud Overpayment — First Offense account (36 months, minimum USD 50.00) with a balance due of USD 3,600.00: exactly USD 100.00, which needs no rounding.
